scope:
A whole-template model with variable Gram and transported complete stars.

The Gram ranges over an exhaustive earlier cover; none is chosen as a seed.
A known six-prism line needs no matching split. Otherwise the canonical
first-component codes are partitioned only by their first matching index.
Every branch must be INFEASIBLE before the whole template can be excluded.

coverage.scope: All star matchings modulo permitted root relabellings. The remaining edges are still variables; these cases are not complete graphs.

model.coverage_scope: One root component template; global coverage requires the source template cover.

first_component_normalization.action: Global independent mate flips only; no graph automorphism assumed.

component_tables.scope: Every true connected line component is covered; no local witness is fixed.

nonroot_partitions.normalization: First occurrence in fixed colour class only.

triangle_structure.scope:
Exact lambda=1 using actual triangle indicators, plus triangle cores.

A Gamma edge sharing a root label already has its common neighbour in
N(o), so lies in no Gamma triangle. Every other Gamma edge lies in exactly
one. Indicators are equivalent to ALL THREE edges being present; merely
choosing an edge decomposition into triangles would be insufficient.

Under C1, every Gamma vertex then lies in exactly five Gamma triangles.
For the 60 vertices outside any root line and its neighbourhood, each
vertex lies in at least one core triangle, and there are exactly 32-t(l)
such triangles, where t(l) is the triangle count in the cubic neighbourhood.
If c(l)=6, those 60 vertices partition into exactly twenty triangles.

More precisely t_H(w)=1+e(C[N_C(w)]). In Gamma coordinates the second
term is the sum of the four possible shared-label star edges at w and
the actual triangles at w whose other two vertices are in the two stars.
These redundant equalities expose the local triangle balance to propagation.

rotation.scope:
Transport a fully fixed star, with any number and sizes of components.

    Its six pairs are already fixed by the caller's exhaustive matching
    branch. Neither a component catalogue nor the opposite matching is used.

grid_intersections.scope:
Expose intersections of transported grids with fixed root grids.

Every induced 3x3 grid D in a Conway graph satisfies A1_D=1+3*1_D.
Thus each exterior vertex has exactly one neighbour in D. Two distinct
grids intersect in zero vertices, one vertex or one whole triangle:
two adjacent intersection vertices force their unique common neighbour;
two nonadjacent intersection vertices force their two common neighbours.
Inside K3 square K3 these closures generate the full grid as soon as the
intersection is not contained in one row or one column.

A transported nine-set is based at an original neighbour a. It omits
the original root and contains no other original neighbour. If it is a
grid, its intersection with an old root grid not containing a therefore
lies in the old four-corner square, which contains no triangle: at most
one corner is shared. If the old grid contains a, the intersection is
already fixed by the four base vertices, and no new corner can lie in it.
These cuts require an actual grid flag; they do not apply to nongrids.

residuals.scope:
Realize the full integer residual of a variable rotated nine-set.

For x=1_S, |S|=9, put d=(A-3I)x-1. The SRG identity gives
Ad=-4d, sum(d)=0 and ||d||^2=56-14e, where S has14+e edges.
Thus e=4 forces A1_S=1+3*1_S at EVERY vertex. For e<=2 the
same exact norm controls all99 coordinates, not just known projections.

Here S consists of an original neighbour a, four fixed Gamma vertices
and four selected Gamma corners. The old root has residual zero. The
fourteen old-neighbour coordinates are label counts, and the84 others
are adjacency sums. We also impose the fourteen old-neighbour -4
equations, which are linear in these residual coordinates.

gram.scope:
Necessary integer Gram and eigen equations for complete rotated stars.

For a new rectangle Q_ij, its nine-set residual is d_ij=-T 1_Qij,
where T^2=7T and T is the projector numerator in the new coordinates.
Consequently, for two DISTINCT rectangles,
  d_ij dot d_ik = -7 e(Q_ij,Q_ik),
  d_ij dot d_kl = 7(4-e(Q_ij,Q_kl))  when i,j,k,l are distinct.
Thus the dot products are divisible by7, nonpositive in the first case,
and at most28 in the second. Norms<=56 bound them below by-56.
Opposite-pair component identities plus incident nonpositivity also force
orthogonality between the two distinct size12 components at a line.

Optional full Gamma eigen equations impose A d=-4d at the84 original
Gamma vertices. The other15 equations already belong to the residual
model. All cuts are necessary; no adjacency or automorphism is assumed.

gram_kernel.scope:
Expose necessary Gram relations already implied by full residual vectors.

    R_pq = dot(delta_p,delta_q)/7, R_pp = 8-2e_p. For every
    root line i, sum_{q incident i} delta_q=0, hence R times its
    incidence column is zero. Every two-by-two principal minor is PSD.
    The vector identity itself is imposed coordinate by coordinate. If
    S_ij is the nine-set and L_i a root triangle, then
      sum_{j!=i} 1_Sij = (A+4I) 1_Li,
    so (A-3I)(A+4I)=2J gives sum_{j!=i} delta_ij=0.
    Since the rectangle incidence columns have squared norm four and
    T is seven times a projector, 0<=R<=28I and sum_q R_pq^2<=28R_pp.
    No component minimum, fixed Gram, or new-root prism budget is used.

full_residual_component_identities.scope:
Transport component relations as FULL vectors, including the old line.

At the new root delta_ij=-T'1_Qij. For each incident line i,
sum_j delta_ij=0. Four nongrid rectangles must split into two opposite
pairs, since c>=4 forces two size12 components. The same pairing flags
are used for known short-vector projections and all residual coordinates.
Only a complete set of fifteen variable rectangles is used here.

templates.scope:
Transport the full c>=4 component-graph cover to a neighbouring root.

No prism budget is imposed at the new root. Use all200 component templates
(116 nongrid graphs), not the79 templates filtered at a low-prism root.
The new seven lines are the old-root line and the six fixed matched pairs
in its Gamma star. Only nongrid status is transported here; missing rotated
rectangles remain free Booleans in the necessary graph-cover table.
An optional frozen exclusion frontier is applied conditionally when the
new root itself has prism sum<=51; larger sums retain the full cover.

profiles.scope:
Transport frozen Gram invariants without choosing a root relabelling.

The21 rectangle vectors are permuted when the seven lines are relabelled.
For their Gram R, sort the21 integers 2048*R_ii+sum_j R_ij^2. All entries
have absolute value<=8, so each row-square sum is<=1344 and this encoding
is injective on (diagonal,row-square sum). The sorted profile is a necessary
invariant of any of the still-open Grams in the frozen complete cover.

Apply this table only at another root whose own prism sum is<=51. The
profile is weaker than a full Gram isomorphism test; no omitted labels or
specific completion are fixed, and roots above51 remain unrestricted.
